card.name: The word same in "same time each day"
card.fires_on: The word "same" in dosing directions such as "at about the same time each day". It also fires on "same day of each week".

modes.label: Same time daily
modes.description: "same" after "at approximately the" in once-daily dosing instructions.
modes.example: Take INLURIYO tablets at approximately the<< same>> time daily.

modes.label: Same day weekly
modes.example: always on the<< same>> day of each week, preferably after the

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning "at this time" or "simultaneously", mostly Chinese terms, which fits the idea of the same moment.
card.plain: It marks the word "same" in instructions to take a medicine at the same time each day.
